values./system/description:
A flamethrower, or flamer, is a weapon which sprays an ignited fuel mixture over an area, essentially creating a jet of flame that can burn or ignite targets at a distance. Ideal for clearing dead foliage, irritating vermin, and fortified bunkers!

A flamer can accept one each of the following mods, which are unique to Flamers and installed with the Repair skill:

  • Fuel: Napalm
  • Barrel: Long Barrel
  • Propellant Tank: Large Tank, Huge Tank
  • Nozzle: Compression Nozzle, Vaporization Nozzle
